title: Universal Video Temporal Grounding with Generative Multi-modal Large Language Models

task_scope.task_family: video moment retrieval / video temporal grounding
task_scope.why_in_or_out: The task explicitly localizes query-relevant temporal moments or highlights.

evidence.quote: # Abstract This paper presents a computational model for universal video temporal grounding, which accurately localizes temporal moments in videos based on natural language queries (e.g., questions or descriptions).
